### US-050: Product search
- Clients filter products by an allowlisted set of fields (category, brand, in_stock).
- Unknown filter fields are ignored rather than erroring.
- Results are capped by a caller-supplied limit.
description: TypeScript twin of sec-neg-01-parameterized-dynamic-sql. Dynamic SQL that LOOKS injectable but is not. The WHERE clause is assembled at runtime, which superficially resembles the sec-ts-01 injection fixture, but column names come only from the FILTERABLE allowlist and every value reaches the driver as an anonymous ? parameter. The allowlist is a Map, so a key such as __proto__ or constructor finds nothing (MDN's Map reference: a Map holds only the keys explicitly put into it, unlike an object's prototype chain), and better-sqlite3's API documentation defines the arguments to Statement#all as bound parameters, never SQL text. A trigger-happy reviewer may flag 'string-built SQL' as injection; that is a false positive.
why_clean: The only interpolated tokens are allowlisted constant column names and '?' placeholders. User-controlled values reach the driver exclusively as bound parameters.
trap: The template-literal SELECT and the AND-joined clause list mimic the shape of an injection sink without being one.
